ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 35% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels concentrated medially and 65% low-intensity black pixels covering the distal regions and leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous regions flanking the median notch. The left region is a large triangular patch with irregular borders and internal dark mottling. The right region is a narrower, elongated band extending laterally. Low-intensity (black) speckled mottling is present within both high-intensity zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrated profile along the entire visible trailing edge. The right lobe mid-section exhibits higher amplitude valleys (deeper notches) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concavity on the trailing edge boundary, tapering to acute, narrow points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, near-parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) clearly visible across the white pigmented areas of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, textured brown clusters (biofouling/barnacle colonization) are visible on the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
